task1.title: How to Make a Cup of Tea
task1.prompt: Write a letter to a friend explaining the process of making a cup of tea. Include the steps involved, the ingredients required, and any tips for making the best tea. You should write at least 150 words.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In today's world, technology plays a crucial role in our communication. Some people believe that technology has improved the quality of communication, while others think it has had a negative impact. Discuss both views and give your opinion on whether technology positively or negatively affects communication. You should write at least 250 words.
